'''Renald Blohk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Renald managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of biochemistry to others.
